hooks.command: command -v dendrite >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; dendrite hook plan-saved; exit 0
command -v dendrite >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; dendrite hook decision; exit 0
command -v dendrite >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; out=$(dendrite hook pre-tool 2>&1); c=$?; case "$out" in *dendrite-first:*) [ "$c" -eq 2 ] && { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0

command -v dendrite >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "blocked: dendrite is not on PATH, so this edit cannot be checked against a ticket claim - install it and run: dendrite session resume" >&2; exit 2; }; out=$(dendrite hook pre-edit 2>&1); c=$?; if [ "$c" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
command -v dendrite >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; dendrite hook session-end; exit 0
